You can set preferences for different diets—from carnivores to calorie-conscious—and choose from 60+ weekly chef-designed recipes. With meal kits delivered on your chosen day, enjoying home-cooked meals is easier than ever. Plus, you have flexibility to skip weeks or cancel anytime as your needs change."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Does HelloFresh offer meal delivery options for special diets?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"HelloFresh’s meal delivery service provides a variety of plans designed to meet different dietary preferences and lifestyles. Whether you’re looking for vegetarian or vegan options with the Veggie plan, calorie-conscious meals under 650 calories with the Fit & Wholesome plan, or seafood-focused recipes with the Pescatarian plan, HelloFresh has you covered. In addition, you can find gluten-free and keto options within these plans and across our rotating menu. With HelloFresh, you can enjoy a convenient meal delivery service tailored to your specific dietary needs."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How many times a week does HelloFresh deliver meal kits?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Once a week. You can expect your meal kit delivery to arrive between 8 am to 8 pm. We deliver anywhere in the United States, except Alaska and Hawaii."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Does HelloFresh give nutrition & calorie information?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Absolutely! We guarantee that every single one of our meal kits is appropriately labeled. They have all the nutritional facts you’re looking for like calorie content and the amount of carbohydrates, protein, dietary fiber, sugar, sodium, unsaturated and saturated fat, and cholesterol."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I recycle my HelloFresh meal boxes?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"You can fold your box and place it with your curbside recyclables, take it to your local recycling center, or even compost it.</br></br>Explore the recycling and packaging page for more details on how to recycle the HelloFresh meal kit box and its contents."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Why should I choose HelloFresh as my meal kit delivery service?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"HelloFresh is America’s #1 meal kit, offering the widest variety of recipes to over a million customers around the country. We have the most five-star recipes and the most five-star reviews among meal kit delivery services according to Trustpilot. HelloFresh was also recognized as having America’s Best Customer Service among meal kit companies by Newsweek in its “America’s Best Customer Service 2020 and 2022” articles. It has also been named the #1 meal kit by USA Today in its “Readers’ Choice Awards” six years running. Beyond the awards and accolades, HelloFresh’s meal service  supports healthier and more sustainable lifestyles."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Do HelloFresh meal kits support a healthy lifestyle?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. HelloFresh offers a wide array of flavorful and nutritious meal kit menu options that cater to a range of dietary needs, including vegetarian, pescatarian, Calorie Smart, Carb Smart and more! By featuring crisp, seasonal vegetables and other fresh produce, we make sure your meal kits are packed with the freshest local ingredients."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I skip a week of meal kit delivery?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. With our meal kit subscription service, you are always in control. If you don’t want to receive a meal kit on a particular week, you don’t have to. To avoid charges when skipping a week, you simply need to “pause” your meal kit order or cancel your meal delivery subscription after logging into your account. Pausing or canceling your meal delivery service should be done by 11:59 pm PST, five days before your next delivery schedule.
